sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: stopping rules, special vehicles, headlights, parking and phones
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Physical pages eighty-one and eighty-two extracted only their printed page numbers, so whatever they show as images was not used (verify NJ-STOP-D-BLANK).
The police stop guidance is printed as a message from the Attorney General; only the document requirement is stated as a legal duty, and the rest is reported as guidance [A06].
The manual heads one lighting item Interim (overhead) lights while describing lights inside the vehicle; the dossier calls them interior overhead lights from that description [A09].
The phone fine ladder and the named vehicular homicide law are reported as printed, with statute citations summarized rather than copied [A11].

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical pages 81 and 82 of the manual extracted no text beyond page numbers; confirm whether they carry image-only content (for example a graphic on emergency vehicles or police stops) that the dossier should cover.
